script_text: Stop right now, Aquarius! The stars are demanding your attention as rebellious Uranus, your modern ruler, charges through your 11th House of Community and Friendships, forming a destabilizing square to Saturn in your 8th House. This electric tension amplifies your need for independence while exposing hidden power struggles in group settings. If you're taken, your partner may challenge your detachment—don't retreat. If single, expect an unexpected connection through shared innovation or humanitarian causes. Financially, avoid risky investments involving technology or friendships today. The cosmos is testing your emotional maturity: lean into vulnerability instead of intellectualizing feelings. Your fixed air element can transform chaos into breakthrough communication. Follow for tomorrow's reading, Aquarius—your future is written in the stars, and you won't want to miss what's coming.
